title: A Breakout Moment for Vivek Ramaswamy

sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我凌晨4点半给总统打电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 太空中的七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60份超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最好的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用不同的起始词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢一锅出的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来一直致力于帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 现在订阅可享受特别优惠，请访问 nytimes.com/subscribe。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: In the Republican presidential race, the battle for second place has been jolted by the sudden
sentences.zh: 在共和党总统竞选中，第二名的争夺战因一位政治新人的突然崛起而受到冲击，

sentences.en: rise of a political newcomer whose popularity has already eclipsed that of far more seasoned candidates.
sentences.zh: 他的受欢迎程度已经超过了许多经验丰富的候选人。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague, Jonathan Weissman, on the backstory, message, and strategy of Vivek
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事乔纳森·韦斯曼将讲述维韦克·拉马斯瓦米的背景故事、主张和策略。

sentences.en: Ramaswamy.
sentences.zh: 拉马斯瓦米。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, August 30th.
sentences.zh: 今天是8月30日，星期三。

sentences.en: Jonathan, for the past week, the story of the Republican presidential race has been, quite unexpectedly, the story of Vivek Ramaswamy.
sentences.zh: 乔纳森，过去一周，共和党总统竞选的故事出人意料地变成了维韦克·拉马斯瓦米的故事。

sentences.en: Remarkable, huh?
sentences.zh: 很了不起，对吧？

sentences.en: Six months ago, Vivek Ramaswamy was, as he says, a skinny little guy with a long name.
sentences.zh: 六个月前，维韦克·拉马斯瓦米正如他自己所说，只是一个名字很长的瘦小家伙。

sentences.en: Nobody knew who he was, but he was out there tilling the soil in Iowa and New Hampshire using his own money, which is copious, and his patented style of saying no to nobody.
sentences.zh: 没人知道他是谁，但他一直在爱荷华州和新罕布什尔州深耕，用着他自己充裕的资金，并运用他那套“从不拒绝任何人”的招牌风格。

sentences.en: This is a guy who will be on any TV show, any podcast, any radio show.
sentences.zh: 他是一个会参加任何电视节目、任何播客、任何广播节目的人。

sentences.en: You ask him, he'll be there.
sentences.zh: 你邀请他，他就会到场。

sentences.en: He could do as many as 30 media hits a day.
sentences.zh: 他一天可以参加多达30场媒体活动。

sentences.en: And that is really his secret.
sentences.zh: 而这正是他的秘诀。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I remember thinking around the end of the spring that this guy was everywhere.
sentences.zh: 我记得春末的时候我就在想，这家伙无处不在。

sentences.en: There was a kind of Vivek ubiquity.
sentences.zh: 有一种“维韦克无处不在”的感觉。

sentences.en: And he was rising in the polls.
sentences.zh: 而且他在民调中不断上升。

sentences.en: He was actually moving upward while Ron DeSantis, who was supposed to be the great threat to
sentences.zh: 他实际上在向上攀升，而本应成为唐纳德·特朗普最大威胁的罗恩·德桑蒂斯，

sentences.en: Donald Trump, is going down in the polls.
sentences.zh: 民调却在下降。

sentences.en: And suddenly, you're starting to see some guy named Vivek Ramaswamy who is about to overtake the second place Republican in the primaries.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，你开始看到一个叫维韦克·拉马斯瓦米的人，他即将超越共和党初选中的第二名。

sentences.en: It was kind of a jolt.
sentences.zh: 这真是一种冲击。

sentences.en: And as if to confirm what we were seeing, these memos leaked out from the super PAC that is trying to boost DeSantis' campaign just ahead of what would be the first debate of
sentences.zh: 为了证实我们所看到的，在2024年共和党初选季首场辩论前夕，

sentences.en: the 2024 Republican primary season.
sentences.zh: 试图提振德桑蒂斯竞选活动的超级政治行动委员会泄露了这些备忘录。

sentences.en: And in those memos, that super PAC says, watch out for Vivek Ramaswamy and hit him hard multiple times when you get onto that stage.
sentences.zh: 在这些备忘录中，该超级政治行动委员会说，要提防维韦克·拉马斯瓦米，一旦登上舞台，就要多次猛烈抨击他。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Nothing could better confirm that Ramaswamy was having a moment than the campaign apparatus
sentences.zh: 没有什么比本应大放异彩的人的竞选团队说“你应该担心这个人，你应该打击他”，更能证明拉马斯瓦米正处于高光时刻了。

sentences.en: around the guy who was supposed to be having a moment saying, you should be worried about this other person and you should be beating him up.
sentences.zh: 本应大放异彩的人的竞选团队说，你得担心这个家伙，你得打击他。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: I mean, Ramaswamy had been saying for months, oh, this is really a two-person race.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，拉马斯瓦米几个月来一直说，哦，这实际上是两个人的竞争。

sentences.en: It's between Donald Trump and me.
sentences.zh: 这是我和唐纳德·特朗普之间的竞争。

sentences.en: And it always kind of sounded like a joke, right?
sentences.zh: 听起来总像是个笑话，对吧？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But then all of a sudden, these documents emerge that look like they worry about the rise of this guy, Vivek Ramaswamy.
sentences.zh: 但突然间，这些文件出现了，看起来他们确实担心这个叫维韦克·拉马斯瓦米的人的崛起。

sentences.en: And then we get to the debate and we're all expecting that Vivek Ramaswamy will take a hit from Ron DeSantis.
sentences.zh: 然后我们到了辩论现场，我们都期待维韦克·拉马斯瓦米会受到罗恩·德桑蒂斯的攻击。

sentences.en: We're all watching for it.
sentences.zh: 我们都在等着看。

sentences.en: And in fact, Vivek Ramaswamy takes multiple hits from multiple candidates.
sentences.zh: 事实上，维韦克·拉马斯瓦米确实受到了多位候选人的多次攻击。

sentences.en: And every time he proved deft, he somehow bobbed and weaved and turned the debate back on his opponents.
sentences.zh: 但每一次他都表现得非常灵巧，他以某种方式闪避、周旋，并将辩论的矛头转回给对手。

sentences.en: And he got exactly what he wanted from that debate because he was the guy they were taking seriously.
sentences.zh: 他从那场辩论中得到了他想要的一切，因为他成了他们认真对待的人。

sentences.en: And he was confirming to the rest of the world what he had been saying to himself for months.
sentences.zh: 他向世界其他地方证实了他几个月来一直对自己说的话。

sentences.en: I'm the guy to beat.
sentences.zh: 我是那个要被击败的人。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And suddenly after that debate, it felt like we were looking at a bonafide breakout moment in this primary for Vivek Ramaswamy.
sentences.zh: 辩论后突然感觉，我们正在见证维韦克·拉马斯瓦米在这次初选中真正的突破时刻。

sentences.en: Of what duration and importance, we can't say at this moment, but a breakout moment nonetheless.
sentences.zh: 至于这种突破能持续多久、有多重要，我们现在还无法断言，但这无疑是一个突破时刻。

sentences.en: And of course, that's why we wanted to talk to you, Jonathan, because you have been covering
sentences.zh: 当然，这就是我们想和你谈谈的原因，乔纳森，因为你已经密切报道

sentences.en: Ramaswamy closely for many months, traveling with him across the country.
sentences.zh: 拉马斯瓦米好几个月了，陪他走遍了全国。

sentences.en: You've gotten to really know him.
sentences.zh: 你已经真正了解他了。

sentences.en: And so we want to talk to you about the full Ramaswamy story, not just the momentum of the past few weeks, but a complete portrait of who he is and how he reached this point.
sentences.zh: 所以我们想和你谈谈拉马斯瓦米的完整故事，不仅仅是过去几周的势头，而是关于他是谁以及他如何走到这一步的完整画像。

sentences.en: So Vivek Ramaswamy is the child of Indian immigrants who were Brahmins, the highest caste in Indian society.
sentences.zh: 维韦克·拉马斯瓦米是印度移民的孩子，他们是婆罗门，是印度社会最高种姓。

sentences.en: His father was an engineer.
sentences.zh: 他的父亲是一名工程师。

sentences.en: He was trained at the MIT of India.
sentences.zh: 他在印度的麻省理工学院接受过培训。

sentences.en: His mother is a psychiatriSt.
sentences.zh: 他的母亲是一名精神科医生。

sentences.en: They settled in a suburb of Cincinnati.
sentences.zh: 他们在辛辛那提郊区定居。

sentences.en: His dad, he likes to say, was a liberal.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢说，他爸爸是个自由派。

sentences.en: And he liked to talk back to his dad and take the contrarian conservative position.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢顶撞他爸爸，并采取相反的保守立场。

sentences.en: And by the time he got to Harvard, he was a libertarian.
sentences.zh: 当他进入哈佛大学时，他已经是一名自由意志主义者了。

sentences.en: He actually had a alter ego called Davek, who was a libertarian rapper.
sentences.zh: 他甚至有一个叫Davek的第二人格，是一个自由意志主义说唱歌手。

sentences.en: But his undergraduate degree is in biology.
sentences.zh: 但他本科的学位是生物学。

sentences.en: And he got a job out of undergraduate as a stock picker for a prominent hedge fund.
sentences.zh: 本科毕业后，他在一家著名的对冲基金找到了一份选股人的工作。

sentences.en: He was a biotech guy and told the hedge fund what biotech companies looked promising.
sentences.zh: 他是生物技术专家，负责告诉对冲基金哪些生物技术公司有前景。

sentences.en: And ultimately, that's how he became very, very rich.
sentences.zh: 最终，他就是这样变得非常有钱的。

sentences.en: When he gets out of Yale Law School, he starts a company, Roy Vant, with a really smart idea
sentences.zh: 从耶鲁法学院毕业后，他创办了一家公司，叫Roy Vant，有一个非常聪明的想法，

sentences.en: of combing through the patent files of the big pharmaceutical companies looking for discarded
sentences.zh: 就是梳理大型制药公司的专利文件，寻找那些被丢弃的

sentences.en: patents that weren't abandoned because they wouldn't necessarily work, but were abandoned because they didn't look particularly profitable for a company as big as, say, Merck.
sentences.zh: 专利，这些专利不是因为行不通而被放弃，而是因为对于像默克公司这样的大公司来说，它们看起来利润不够丰厚。

sentences.en: And he thought, well, I'm going to buy the patent cheap, and I'm going to develop them cheap.
sentences.zh: 他想，好吧，我要低价买下这些专利，然后低成本开发它们。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: You're saying he's basically selling bargain basement patents that everybody else has more or less abandoned.
sentences.zh: 你是说他基本上是在兜售别人多多少少已经放弃的廉价专利。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And he had a lot of success.
sentences.zh: 他非常成功。

sentences.en: He was involved in bringing about five different drugs to market, which in the biotech world is a pretty good track record.
sentences.zh: 他参与了大约五种不同药物的上市，这在生物技术领域是一个相当不错的记录。

sentences.en: But the drug that really put him on the map was, in fact, a failure.
sentences.zh: 但真正让他声名鹊起的那种药，实际上是一个失败的产品。

sentences.en: Mr. Ramaswamy, welcome to Bad Money.
sentences.zh: 拉马斯瓦米先生，欢迎来到《坏钱》节目。

sentences.en: Good to see you, sir.
sentences.zh: 很高兴见到你，先生。

sentences.en: Very good to see you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴见到你。

sentences.en: A drug to address Alzheimer's.
sentences.zh: 一种治疗阿尔茨海默病的药物。

sentences.en: Tell me why Glaxo kind of wrote this drug off, and yet you have such great hopes for it.
sentences.zh: 告诉我为什么葛兰素史克放弃了这种药，而你却对它抱有如此大的希望。

sentences.en: I actually think the potential opportunity here is really tremendous for delivering value to patients.
sentences.zh: 我实际上认为，为患者创造价值的潜在机会确实非常巨大。

sentences.en: Ramaswamy just went everywhere in the biotech world and pitched this idea that he was going to bring an Alzheimer's drug to market.
sentences.zh: 拉马斯瓦米在生物技术领域到处推销这个想法，说他要将一种阿尔茨海默病药物推向市场。

sentences.en: Actually, we believe we're only one additional phase three study away from the approval of this drug on a global basis.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们相信我们距离在全球范围内批准这种药物仅差一项额外的三期研究。

sentences.en: He pumped up the stock price of his company and its subsidiary, Axovent, way high.
sentences.zh: 他把他的公司及其子公司Axovent的股价炒得非常高。

sentences.en: When I see a red hot stock, I don't want to get people hurt.
sentences.zh: 当我看到一只大热股票时，我不想让人们受损。

sentences.en: You know that.
sentences.zh: 你知道的。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: It got one drug, and everyone hopes that it works.
sentences.zh: 它有一种药，每个人都希望它能奏效。

sentences.en: I think you're asking all the right questions.
sentences.zh: 我想你问的问题都很到位。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Fair enough.
sentences.zh: 说得有道理。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Well, we're going to be following the situation.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们会持续关注事态发展。

sentences.en: And then, lo and behold, it didn't work.
sentences.zh: 然后，你瞧，它没起作用。

sentences.en: It failed.
sentences.zh: 它失败了。

sentences.en: The subsidiary collapsed.
sentences.zh: 子公司倒闭了。

sentences.en: A lot of people took a bath.
sentences.zh: 很多人损失惨重。

sentences.en: But the way this structure was set up for his company, Ramaswamy did fine.
sentences.zh: 但由于他公司这种结构的设置方式，拉马斯瓦米安然无恙。

sentences.en: In fact, by the time he's 35, he's made $200 million.
sentences.zh: 事实上，到他35岁时，他已经赚了2亿美元。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So that sounds a bit like the story of a charismatic salesman telling people what they want to hear, which doesn't seem like that big a stretch or leap from politics.
sentences.zh: 这听起来有点像一个魅力十足的推销员告诉人们他们想听的话的故事，这似乎与政治并没有太大的区别。

sentences.en: No, exactly.
sentences.zh: 不，完全正确。

sentences.en: In fact, he was in some ways born to politics.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他在某种程度上是为政治而生的。

sentences.en: This is a guy who knows how to sell himself.
sentences.zh: 这是一个懂得如何推销自己的人。

sentences.en: And why does he eventually turn his attention to politics?
sentences.zh: 他为什么最终将注意力转向政治？

sentences.en: It goes back to 2020 and the Black Lives Matter protests that erupted after George Floyd's murder.
sentences.zh: 这要追溯到2020年乔治·弗洛伊德被谋杀后爆发的“黑人的命也是命”抗议活动。

sentences.en: Remember, at that time, CEOs from companies large and small were speaking out in favor of the Black Lives Matter protesters and against systemic racism, against police violence.
sentences.zh: 记得当时，大大小小公司的首席执行官们都在公开支持“黑人的命也是命”抗议者，反对系统性种族主义，反对警察暴力。

sentences.en: And Ramaswamy wasn't insulated from those trends.
sentences.zh: 拉马斯瓦米并没有与这些趋势隔绝。

sentences.en: In fact, he was under pressure from employees of his company, Roy Vant, to be out there, to speak out.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他当时正承受着他公司Roy Vant员工的压力，要求他站出来表态。

sentences.en: And he said, no, it is not the role of a chief executive officer of a company with fiduciary responsibilities to its shareholders to get involved in politics at all.
sentences.zh: 他说，不，对于一家对股东负有受托责任的公司来说，首席执行官根本不应该参与政治。

sentences.en: Now, joining me, Vivek Ramaswamy, big corporate entities embracing woke politics whole cloth.
sentences.zh: 现在，加入我的节目的是维韦克·拉马斯瓦米，大型企业实体全盘接受觉醒政治。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Big business in this country decided to enter an arranged marriage with the new woke left.
sentences.zh: 这个国家的商业巨头决定与新的觉醒左派进行包办婚姻。

sentences.en: And it's more like mutual prostitution because each side gets something out of the trade.
sentences.zh: 这更像是相互卖淫，因为双方都能从交易中得到好处。

sentences.en: He started appearing on Fox News.
sentences.zh: 他开始出现在福克斯新闻上。

sentences.en: But these woke values are really easy.
sentences.zh: 但这些觉醒价值观真的很简单。

sentences.en: They love anti-racism because they could applaud diversity and inclusion, put some token minorities on their boards.
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢反种族主义，因为他们可以为多元化和包容性鼓掌，在董事会里安插几个少数族裔作为点缀。

sentences.en: He alienated a lot of very big name Democrats who were advisors to his company.
sentences.zh: 他疏远了许多担任他公司顾问的知名民主党人。

sentences.en: And he also alienated some of the employees of his company so much so that within months of his first commentary in public, he had stepped back, left as CEO, and was writing a book
sentences.zh: 他还疏远了一些公司员工，以至于在他首次公开评论后的几个月内，他就退出了首席执行官职位，并写了一本书，

sentences.en: called Woke Inc., a jeremiad against liberal politics in corporate board suites.
sentences.zh: 书名叫《觉醒公司》，这是一篇针对企业董事会中自由派政治的檄文。

sentences.en: He follows up his first book, Woke Inc., with two other books and translates that to a lot of appearances on Fox News, on Fox Business.
sentences.zh: 他继第一本书《觉醒公司》之后又写了两本书，并将其转化为在福克斯新闻和福克斯商业频道上的大量露面。

sentences.en: He starts making a name for himself in conservative circles.
sentences.zh: 他开始在保守派圈子里名声大噪。

sentences.en: And he decides, I want to run for president.
sentences.zh: 他决定，我要竞选总统。

sentences.en: And he seems to be driven by his fear of wokeism from the left, that society is under assault from liberal activism.
sentences.zh: 他似乎是被对左翼“觉醒主义”的恐惧所驱动，认为社会正受到自由派激进主义的攻击。

sentences.en: And when he finally announces his run for president, he does so with a vision for this country and its society that is extremely dark.
sentences.zh: 当他最终宣布竞选总统时，他所提出的关于这个国家及其社会的愿景是非常黑暗的。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·朗森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重塑者》，这是一个关于设计之爱及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like
sentences.zh: 即使在我还在黑胶唱片时代在夜总会当DJ的时候，每天晚上你都要带着300件你最珍贵的财产去工作，你把DJ台变成了一个

sentences.en: living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 活生生的、充满50年历史精美文物的快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼带来的《重塑者》吧。

sentences.en: I'm Wena Lowe.
sentences.zh: 我是韦娜·洛。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写了《纽约时报》游戏中的拼图游戏之一《Connections》。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢尝试捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天负责创建《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”的特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由人制作的，就像你刚才听到的那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 即可立即开始游戏。

sentences.en: So Jonathan, tell us more about this dark message at the heart of Ramaswamy's eventual presidential campaign.
sentences.zh: 乔纳森，跟我们多讲讲拉马斯瓦米总统竞选活动核心的那条黑暗信息吧。

sentences.en: Well, nothing captures that message more than the video that launched him.
sentences.zh: 嗯，没有什么比他发布的那段视频更能体现这一信息了。

sentences.en: We're in the middle of a national identity crisis.
sentences.zh: 我们正处于一场国家认同危机的中心。

sentences.en: Faith, patriotism, and hard work have disappeared.
sentences.zh: 信仰、爱国主义和勤奋工作已经消失了。

sentences.en: He speaks of a hole in our soul, a darkness in the American society.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了我们灵魂中的空洞，谈到了美国社会中的黑暗。

sentences.en: We hunger to be part of something bigger than ourselves, yet we cannot even answer the question of what it means to be an American.
sentences.zh: 我们渴望成为比自身更宏大事物的一部分，然而我们甚至无法回答“身为美国人意味着什么”这个问题。

sentences.en: Today, the woke left preys on that vacuum.
sentences.zh: 如今，“觉醒”左派正利用这种真空进行掠夺。

sentences.en: They tell you that your race, your gender, and your sexual orientation govern who you are, what you can achieve, and what you're allowed to think.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉你，你的种族、性别和性取向决定了你是谁、你能取得什么成就，以及你被允许思考什么。

sentences.en: This is psychological slavery.
sentences.zh: 这是一种心理奴役。

sentences.en: And his message is that he can bring the country back from this morass.
sentences.zh: 而他传达的信息是，他能将国家从这种泥潭中拯救出来。

sentences.en: And that is why today I am announcing my run for president of the United States.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么今天我宣布参加美国总统竞选。

sentences.en: This isn't just a political campaign.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是一场政治竞选。

sentences.en: This is a cultural movement to create a new American dream for the next generation.
sentences.zh: 这是一场为下一代创造新美国梦的文化运动。

sentences.en: Jonathan, some of this candidly feels a bit familiar for the Republican Party in the era of Donald Trump,
sentences.zh: 乔纳森，坦白说，在唐纳德·特朗普时代，这对于共和党来说感觉有些熟悉，

sentences.en: who has long railed, for instance, against political correctness and woke culture.
sentences.zh: 他长期以来一直抨击政治正确和“觉醒”文化。

sentences.en: So what, in your mind, and I guess in Ramaswamy's mind, makes this distinct?
sentences.zh: 那么，在你看来，或者说在拉马斯瓦米看来，这有什么独特之处？

sentences.en: You know, it's not just his diagnosis of what Donald Trump called American carnage.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这不仅仅是他对唐纳德·特朗普所说的“美国大屠杀”的诊断。

sentences.en: It's his remedy.
sentences.zh: 这是他的补救措施。

sentences.en: It's the details to actually do something about it that pulls his agenda much farther to the right of Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 正是这些旨在真正解决问题的细节，使他的议程比唐纳德·特朗普更偏向右翼。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Explain that.
sentences.zh: 解释一下。

sentences.en: Well, for instance, remember, Donald Trump kind of invented the notion of the deep state.
sentences.zh: 嗯，比如，记住，唐纳德·特朗普算是发明了“深层政府”这个概念。

sentences.en: Well, Ramaswamy talks about the administrative state, and he says that he would do things that Trump never dreamed of.
sentences.zh: 而拉马斯瓦米谈论的是“行政国家”，他说他会做特朗普从未梦想过的事情。

sentences.en: The people who we elect to run the government ought to be the ones who actually run the government.
sentences.zh: 我们选举出来管理政府的人，理应是真正管理政府的人。

sentences.en: He's talking about cutting 75 percent of the federal workforce, illuminating the Department of Education, the IRS, the FBI.
sentences.zh: 他谈到要裁减75%的联邦工作人员，撤销教育部、国税局和联邦调查局。

sentences.en: He's talking about gutting the administrative state, not just railing against it.
sentences.zh: 他谈到要彻底铲除行政国家，而不仅仅是抨击它。

sentences.en: We will shut them down.
sentences.zh: 我们将关闭它们。

sentences.en: And that's just the very beginning of his agenda.
sentences.zh: 而这仅仅是他议程的开始。

sentences.en: So in the first day of my campaign, I pledged to do something, which is to use U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以在我竞选的第一天，我就承诺要做一件事，那就是在必要时使用美国

sentences.en: military force, if necessary, to address the Mexican drug cartels, who, yes, are terrorist organizations.
sentences.zh: 军事力量来对付墨西哥贩毒集团，是的，他们就是恐怖组织。

sentences.en: This is a guy who talks about taking U.S.
sentences.zh: 这家伙谈论的是动用美国

sentences.en: troops and actually attacking Mexican cartels in Mexico.
sentences.zh: 军队，并在墨西哥境内实际打击墨西哥贩毒集团。

sentences.en: Well, I don't think citizenship should be something that anybody automatically takes for granted, born here or not.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我不认为公民身份应该是任何人自动视为理所当然的事情，无论是否出生在这里。

sentences.en: He talks about ending birthright citizenship, which would mean that the children of undocumented immigrants born on U.S.
sentences.zh: 他谈到要终结出生公民权，这意味着出生在美国土地上的无证移民子女

sentences.en: soil would no longer be American citizens.
sentences.zh: 将不再是美国公民。

sentences.en: Why are you against the boarding agreement?
sentences.zh: 你为什么反对边境协议？

sentences.en: Because it does not advance American interests.
sentences.zh: 因为它不符合美国的利益。

sentences.en: And as the U.S.
sentences.zh: 作为美国

sentences.en: president, I'm not running for any other role other than looking after the interests of Americans.
sentences.zh: 总统，我竞选的目的除了维护美国人的利益之外，别无他求。

sentences.en: And then, if anything, his foreign policy is even farther to the right, certainly a swing toward isolationism.
sentences.zh: 而且，如果说有什么不同的话，他的外交政策甚至更偏右，无疑是向孤立主义的转向。

sentences.en: He talks about not giving another dime of military aid to Ukraine, but he even goes farther.
sentences.zh: 他谈到不再给乌克兰一分钱的军事援助，但他甚至走得更远。

sentences.en: I would freeze the current lines of control, and that would leave parts of the Donbass region with Russia.
sentences.zh: 我会冻结当前的控制线，这将使顿巴斯地区的部分地区留在俄罗斯手中。

sentences.en: He says he would give Vladimir Putin eastern Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 他说他会把乌克兰东部交给弗拉基米尔·普京。

sentences.en: Our engagement in Ukraine is further driving Russia into China's arMs.
sentences.zh: 我们在乌克兰的参与正进一步将俄罗斯推向中国的怀抱。

sentences.en: So my foreign policy centers on weakening that alliance.
sentences.zh: 所以我的外交政策核心是削弱那个联盟。

sentences.en: He says we need to make friends with Vladimir Putin.
sentences.zh: 他说我们需要与弗拉基米尔·普京交朋友。

sentences.en: He doesn't trust Putin, but he wants to woo Putin away from China.
sentences.zh: 他不信任普京，但他想把普京从中国身边拉拢过来。

sentences.en: And to do that, he's willing to give up the sovereignty of a would-be ally, Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 为了做到这一点，他愿意放弃一个潜在盟友——乌克兰的主权。

sentences.en: And if we rediscover who we really are, then we can actually stand up to the actual threats we face on the global stage.
sentences.zh: 如果我们重新发现我们真正的身份，那么我们就能真正站起来面对我们在全球舞台上所面临的实际威胁。

sentences.en: And the top of the list, it isn't in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 而名单上的首位，不在乌克兰。

sentences.en: It is communist China.
sentences.zh: 而是共产主义中国。

sentences.en: And he talks about that the most important piece of his foreign policy is to confront China and to break the United States' dependence on China.
sentences.zh: 他谈到他外交政策中最重要的一点是对抗中国，并打破美国对中国的依赖。

sentences.en: That is our number one threat that we face in the next century.
sentences.zh: 这是我们在下个世纪面临的第一大威胁。

sentences.en: Similarly, he seems ready to give up on Taiwan.
sentences.zh: 同样，他似乎准备放弃台湾。

sentences.en: We are dependent on a tiny island nation off the southeast coast of China for our entire modern way of life in the United States of America.
sentences.zh: 我们整个现代生活方式都依赖于中国东南沿海的一个小岛国。

sentences.en: He's actually said out loud many times that he would spend the first four years of his presidency
sentences.zh: 他实际上多次大声说过，他将把总统任期的前四年用于

sentences.en: building up the domestic semiconductor industry so we would no longer be dependent on Taiwan for semiconductors.
sentences.zh: 建立国内半导体产业，这样我们就不会再在半导体方面依赖台湾了。

sentences.en: And then at the end of those four years, he would no longer defend Taiwan.
sentences.zh: 然后在四年结束时，他将不再保卫台湾。

sentences.en: Basically signaling to Beijing, take it.
sentences.zh: 基本上是在向北京发出信号：拿走吧。

sentences.en: It's yours.
sentences.zh: 它是你们的了。

sentences.en: And we will not take the risk of war that risks American lives after that for some nationalistic dispute between China and Taiwan.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，我们不会冒着牺牲美国人生命的战争风险，去介入中国和台湾之间某种民族主义争端。

sentences.en: And then that leads to actually perhaps maybe his most controversial position, at least in Republican politics.
sentences.zh: 这引出了他也许最具争议的立场，至少在共和党政治中是这样。

sentences.en: He'd like to further the bilateral peace agreements that Israel is pursuing with its neighbors so he can stop giving military aid to Israel.
sentences.zh: 他希望推进以色列与其邻国正在寻求的双边和平协议，这样他就可以停止向以色列提供军事援助。

sentences.en: Now, aid to Israel is sacrosanct in the Republican Party, but he's saying, you know, eventually we don't need to do that either.
sentences.zh: 现在，对以色列的援助在共和党内是神圣不可侵犯的，但他却说，你知道，最终我们也不需要那样做了。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 呵。

sentences.en: Jonathan, you started to hint at this, but these are extremely unorthodox views of American foreign policy, period.
sentences.zh: 乔纳森，你刚才开始暗示这一点，但这些都是极其非正统的美国外交政策观点，句号。

sentences.en: And especially for a Republican when it comes to Taiwan and Israel, defending those two have been pillars of modern Republican foreign policy.
sentences.zh: 尤其是对于共和党人来说，在台湾和以色列问题上，保卫这两个地方一直是现代共和党外交政策的支柱。

sentences.en: So what do you make of that?
sentences.zh: 那么你是怎么看待这一点的？

sentences.en: Well, it's not only radical, but if you just look under the surface, some of this doesn't make a lot of sense.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这不仅激进，而且如果你仔细观察，其中一些观点根本说不通。

sentences.en: I mean, he says that we're going to confront China in every way, but that somehow we will, you know, have four years to build up a semiconductor industry so China can have Taiwan.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他说我们要全方位对抗中国，但不知何故，我们会有四年时间来建立半导体产业，以便中国可以拿走台湾。

sentences.en: That doesn't make a lot of sense for a confrontation.
sentences.zh: 这对于对抗来说并不合理。

sentences.en: But also, how does he know that in four years we'll be able to build up a semiconductor industry that's totally independent of Taiwan?
sentences.zh: 而且，他怎么知道四年后我们就能建立起一个完全不依赖台湾的半导体产业？

sentences.en: How does he know that China won't invade before four years?
sentences.zh: 他怎么知道中国不会在四年内入侵？

sentences.en: It's like the world doesn't work the way he wants it to, but he's almost willing it to work the way he wants it to.
sentences.zh: 这就像世界并没有按照他想要的方式运转，但他几乎是在强行让它按照他想要的方式运转。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He's saying the arguments don't add up, they're flawed, and they are not representative of someone who's really understood geopolitics.
sentences.zh: 他在说这些论点站不住脚，是有缺陷的，而且不能代表一个真正了解地缘政治的人。

sentences.en: I mean, this has led foreign policy experts, including conservative foreign policy experts, to say that Vivek Ramaswamy is just engaged in bizarre, magical thinking.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这导致外交政策专家，包括保守派外交政策专家，都说维韦克·拉马斯瓦米只是在进行一种离奇的、魔幻的思考。

sentences.en: Remember, on the debate stage, Nikki Haley looked at him and said, you don't know what you're talking about.
sentences.zh: 记得在辩论台上，尼基·黑利看着他说，你根本不知道自己在说什么。

sentences.en: You've never conducted foreign policy, and it shows.
sentences.zh: 你从未执行过外交政策，这显而易见。

sentences.en: If ideas like this don't make sense, why is Ramaswamy even articulating that?
sentences.zh: 如果这样的想法说不通，为什么拉马斯瓦米还要表达出来？

sentences.en: I mean, it's not clear to me that Republican voters need him to make a four-part argument around Taiwan that results in it being given back to China.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我不清楚共和党选民是否需要他围绕台湾提出一个四部分的论点，结果却是把它交还给中国。

sentences.en: So why is he even treading there?
sentences.zh: 那么他为什么要涉足那里？

sentences.en: What you need to know about Vivek Ramaswamy is that he has this quality about him that anticipates what people want to hear and gives them what they want,
sentences.zh: 关于维韦克·拉马斯瓦米，你需要知道的是，他有一种特质，能预判人们想听什么，并给他们想要的东西，

sentences.en: whether it's the truth or not.
sentences.zh: 无论那是否是事实。

sentences.en: I remember being in New Hampshire, and a woman stood up and said that she really didn't like all this anti-wokeism, that it seemed beside the point to her.
sentences.zh: 我记得在新罕布什尔州，一位女士站起来说她真的很不喜欢所有这些反“觉醒”主义，这对她来说似乎无关紧要。

sentences.en: And he said, oh, I'm not really into that stuff anymore.
sentences.zh: 他说，哦，我其实不再热衷于那些东西了。

sentences.en: But in the back of the room, they were giving out little buttons that said, stop wokeism, vote Vivek.
sentences.zh: 但在房间后面，他们正在分发写着“停止觉醒主义，投票给维韦克”的小徽章。

sentences.en: Wait, how could you not be into wokeism?
sentences.zh: 等等，你怎么可能不热衷于觉醒主义？

sentences.en: That's his whole campaign.
sentences.zh: 那是他的整个竞选活动。

sentences.en: That's his whole campaign.
sentences.zh: 那是他的整个竞选活动。

sentences.en: And yet he said he's not into it anymore.
sentences.zh: 然而他说他不再热衷于它了。

sentences.en: He says these things a lot.
sentences.zh: 他经常说这些话。

sentences.en: I remember following him to the south side of Chicago.
sentences.zh: 我记得曾跟随他去芝加哥南区。

sentences.en: He was there to talk about his immigration policies because they were settling migrants shipped up from Texas in the south side.
sentences.zh: 他在那里谈论他的移民政策，因为他们正在安置从德克萨斯州运到南区的移民。

sentences.en: And the community was getting upset.
sentences.zh: 社区对此感到不满。

sentences.en: He thought he was going to be able to stir the pot with black Chicagoans about this.
sentences.zh: 他以为他能就此事煽动芝加哥黑人。

sentences.en: But they were much more interested in really peppering him on his opposition to affirmative action, on his belief that there's no such thing as systemic racism.
sentences.zh: 但他们更感兴趣的是就他反对平权行动、他认为不存在系统性种族主义的观点对他进行盘问。

sentences.en: And then nobody asked about immigration, just nobody.
sentences.zh: 结果没人问移民问题，根本没人问。

sentences.en: And I was in Iowa just a few days ago, and he had this shtick where he said, nowhere were they more interested in my immigration policies and my promise to go after the cartels
sentences.zh: 几天前我在爱荷华州，他有个惯用伎俩，他说，没有哪个地方比芝加哥南区的全黑人听众更对我的移民政策和打击贩毒集团的承诺感兴趣了。

sentences.en: than in the south side of Chicago in an all-black audience.
sentences.zh: 我记得我在笔记里写道，这是谎言。

sentences.en: I remember writing in my notes, this is a lie.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 所以很明显，他的信息具有激进的特质。

sentences.en: So it's clear that his message has a radical quality to it.
sentences.zh: 他所说内容的实质有时会违背逻辑和实用性。

sentences.en: The content of what he's saying can at times strain logic and practicality.
sentences.zh: 你在实地花了很多时间陪他。

sentences.en: You're spending all this time with him out in the field.
sentences.zh: 你交谈和观察到的选民是如何接受所有这些信息和内容的？

sentences.en: How are voters that you're talking to and watching receiving all of this messaging and content?
sentences.zh: 关于维韦克·拉马斯瓦米，他散发出的自信如此强烈，以至于无论他说什么听起来都像是对的。

sentences.en: The thing about Vivek Ramaswamy is that he exudes confidence so much that whatever he says sounds correct.
sentences.zh: 他说话条理清晰，以至于他不会让你去分析他所说的是否合乎逻辑。

sentences.en: He speaks with such clarity that he doesn't invite you to analyze whether what he said was logical or not.
sentences.zh: 我记得无论走到哪里，我都会在活动结束后与人们交谈，他们总是说他太聪明了。

sentences.en: And I remember everywhere I go, I talk to people after his events, and they always say he is so brilliant.
sentences.zh: 他们确信他所说的任何话一定是对的，因为他说得太好了。

sentences.en: They are convinced that whatever he said had to be right because he said it so well.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这听起来他在生物技术领域的推销员成功经验，非常自然地转化为了在竞选活动中推销他自己作为总统的形象。

sentences.en: I mean, it sounds like his success as a salesman in biotech is very naturally translating into selling the idea of himself as president on the campaign trail.
sentences.zh: 这很引人注目，因为显然唐纳德·特朗普最初就是那个说“我是商人，不是政客，但我能带来我的商业智慧”的人，

sentences.en: It is remarkable because obviously Donald Trump was the guy who said originally,
sentences.zh: 嗯，维韦克·拉马斯瓦米说了同样的话，但他以一种更令人信服的方式说了出来。

sentences.en: I'm a businessman, not a politician, but I can bring my business smart.
sentences.zh: 他听起来好像拥有所有的答案。

sentences.en: Well, Vivek Ramaswamy says the same thing, but he says it in a much more convincing way.
sentences.zh: 嗯，说到特朗普，乔纳森，我很好奇拉马斯瓦米是否在进行一场基本上比特朗普更右的竞选活动。

sentences.en: He sounds like he has all of the answers.
sentences.zh: 他如何看待自己作为这场竞选中特朗普竞争对手的关系？

sentences.en: Well, speaking of Trump, Jonathan, I'm curious if Ramaswamy is running a campaign that's basically to the right of Trump.
sentences.zh: 他不想挑战特朗普。

sentences.en: How does he think about his relationship to Trump as a rival in this campaign?
sentences.zh: 他不想疏远特朗普的选民。

sentences.en: He doesn't want to challenge Trump.
sentences.zh: 我认为他整个理论的基础是，会发生某种事件让特朗普倒台。

sentences.en: He doesn't want to alienate Trump's voters.
sentences.zh: 也许他会被定罪。

sentences.en: I think his whole theory of the case is that there will be some event that takes Trump down.
sentences.zh: 也许他只是无法挺过所有这些法庭案件。

sentences.en: Maybe he'll be convicted.
sentences.zh: 而维韦克·拉马斯瓦米将处于能够吞并所有这些特朗普支持者的位置，因为毕竟，他比特朗普更特朗普。

sentences.en: Maybe he just can't make it through all of these court cases.
sentences.zh: 你知道，很多人认为维韦克竞选是为了成为唐纳德·特朗普的副总统。

sentences.en: And that Vivek Ramaswamy will be in the position to gobble up all of those Trump supporters because, after all, he is more Trump than Trump.
sentences.zh: 我认为他只想成为总统。

sentences.en: You know, a lot of people think Vivek is running to be Donald Trump's vice president.
sentences.zh: 这家伙在30出头时就是首席执行官了。

sentences.en: I think he only wants to be president.
sentences.zh: 他只想成为那个处于顶端的人。

sentences.en: This is a guy who was a CEO in his early 30s.
sentences.zh: 他认为那是他的命运。

sentences.en: He only wants to be the guy on top.
sentences.zh: 你刚才概述的情况，即特朗普因某种原因无法参选，最终无法成为提名人，

sentences.en: And he thinks that's his destiny.
sentences.zh: 这一直是这场竞选中其他候选人的预想策略，最著名的当然是

sentences.en: What you just outlined, that Trump can't run for some reason, can't end up being the nominee,
sentences.zh: 罗恩·德桑蒂斯，他的政策立场似乎与拉马斯瓦米有相当多的重叠。

sentences.en: that has been the presumed strategy of other candidates in this race, most notably, of course,
sentences.zh: 他，德桑蒂斯，也是以反“觉醒”孤立主义者的身份参选的。

sentences.en: Ron DeSantis, whose policy positions, it would seem, overlap a fair bit with Ramaswamy.
sentences.zh: 但拉马斯瓦米比罗恩·德桑蒂斯更偏右。
zh_words: 拉马斯瓦米比罗恩·德桑蒂斯

sentences.en: He, too, DeSantis, is running as an anti-woke isolationiSt.
sentences.zh: 他比罗恩·德桑蒂斯更平易近人，在竞选活动中是一个更自然的候选人。

sentences.en: But Ramaswamy is farther to the right than Ron DeSantis.
sentences.zh: 而且与德桑蒂斯不同，他从不批评唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: He is more personable than Ron DeSantis, just a much more natural candidate on the campaign trail.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他在辩论台上说，他是21世纪最伟大的总统。

sentences.en: And unlike DeSantis, he never criticizes Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 他说过他会赦免唐纳德·特朗普的任何定罪或指控，无论是什么。

sentences.en: In fact, he said on the debate stage, he is the greatest president of the 21st century.
sentences.zh: 他唯一的批评，也许是说他能做唐纳德·特朗普做不到的事，但唐纳德·特朗普永远是他的灵感来源。

sentences.en: He has said he will pardon Donald Trump for any convictions or any charges, regardless.
sentences.zh: 我想谈谈拉马斯瓦米正在经历这一突破性时刻意味着什么，并附带一个非常重要的警告，即这只是一个时刻，它可能会改变，

sentences.en: His only criticism, perhaps, would be that he can do what Donald Trump wasn't able to do, but that Donald Trump will always be his inspiration.
sentences.zh: 他可能会在民调中暴跌，就像共和党拥挤领域中许多昙花一现的候选人一样。

sentences.en: I want to talk about what it means that Ramaswamy is having this breakout moment, with the really important caveat that it's just a moment, that it could change,
sentences.zh: 但知道他现在做得这么好，这感觉非常有说明意义，即共和党领域中两个最可行的二号人物人选都如此像特朗普，对吧？

sentences.en: that he could plunge in the polls, as so many hot-burning candidates do in crowded Republican fields.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，一个是拉马斯瓦米，他如此像特朗普，以至于他在许多问题上比特朗普更右。

sentences.en: But knowing that he's doing this well now, it feels very telling that the two most viable candidates to be the number two in the Republican field are so Trump-like, right?
sentences.zh: 而德桑蒂斯，稍微少一点，但喜欢把自己看作是可当选的特朗普，即没有包袱的特朗普。

sentences.en: I mean, one, Ramaswamy, so Trump-like that he's to the right of Trump on many issues.
sentences.zh: 如果你把特朗普、拉马斯瓦米和德桑蒂斯的所有支持者加在一起，你就拥有了共和党选民中非常大的一部分。

sentences.en: And DeSantis, a little less so, but likes to see himself as the electable Trump, the Trump without the baggage.
sentences.zh: 这似乎表明，在现阶段，特朗普主义可能根本不仅仅是关于特朗普，

sentences.en: If you put all the supporters of Trump, Ramaswamy, and DeSantis together, you have a really large chunk of the Republican electorate.
sentences.zh: 而是关于整个共和党在过去几年里向右偏移了多远。

sentences.en: And what that seems to suggest is that Trumpism might not just be about Trump at all at this stage,
sentences.zh: 这似乎表明，在现阶段，特朗普主义可能根本不仅仅是关于特朗普，

sentences.en: but about just how far rightward the entire Republican Party has shifted over the past few years.
sentences.zh: 而是关于整个共和党在过去几年里向右偏移了多远。

sentences.en: When that many candidates are all this conservative, you're clearly no longer just talking about Trump and his base.
sentences.zh: 当这么多候选人都如此保守时，很明显，你们讨论的早已不仅仅是特朗普及其基本盘了。

sentences.en: The Republican Party is now the party of right-wing populism.
sentences.zh: 共和党现在已经成了右翼民粹主义政党。

sentences.en: The old Republican Party of George W.
sentences.zh: 乔治·W·布什时期的那种旧共和党保守主义

sentences.en: Bush conservatism is gone.
sentences.zh: 已经不复存在了。

sentences.en: We have candidates trying to run that way in Chris Christie or Asa Hutchinson or even Mike Pence.
sentences.zh: 我们有克里斯·克里斯蒂、阿萨·哈钦森甚至迈克·彭斯这样的候选人试图走那条老路。

sentences.en: But I'm at these events.
sentences.zh: 但我参加了这些活动。

sentences.en: I talk to these people.
sentences.zh: 我与这些人交谈过。

sentences.en: They want somebody who is going to reflect their own skepticism and cynicism of where this country is, that sense that they are under assault.
sentences.zh: 他们想要的是一个能反映他们对国家现状的怀疑和愤世嫉俗，以及那种感到自己正受到攻击的人。

sentences.en: And the candidate who really grapples with their own negativity is the one that seems to be getting their allegiance.
sentences.zh: 而真正能抓住他们这种负面情绪的候选人，似乎就能赢得他们的忠诚。

sentences.en: Right now, that's Donald Trump, but it could be Vivek Ramaswamy, who's willing to push dark visions of society into places we never dreamed of.
sentences.zh: 目前看来是唐纳德·特朗普，但也可能是维韦克·拉马斯瓦米，他愿意把对社会的阴暗愿景推向我们从未想象过的地步。

sentences.en: Well, Jonathan, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，乔纳森，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: You're welcome.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你邀请我。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·罗森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档关于热爱设计及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you
sentences.zh: 即使是在我还在黑胶唱片时代去夜店打碟的时候，你每天晚上都要带着300件最珍贵的宝贝去工作，

sentences.en: and you turned a DJ booth into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你把DJ台变成了一个活生生的、充满美感且有50年历史的艺术品快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼出品的《重构者》吧。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: This storm is very strong and is expected to strengthen to a major hurricane by the time it makes landfall.
sentences.zh: 这场风暴非常强劲，预计在登陆时将增强为大型飓风。

sentences.en: Hurricane Adalia was expected to become a Category 4-strength storm by landfall this morning,
sentences.zh: 飓风“伊达利亚”预计在今天上午登陆时将达到四级飓风强度，

sentences.en: delivering potentially catastrophic winds, rain, and flooding to Florida's northern Gulf CoaSt.
sentences.zh: 给佛罗里达州北部墨西哥湾沿岸带来潜在的灾难性大风、降雨和洪水。

sentences.en: Residents in at least 28 counties were ordered to evacuate their homes, mostly because of a storm surge that could reach up to 15 feet.
sentences.zh: 至少28个县的居民被要求撤离家园，主要是因为风暴潮可能高达15英尺。

sentences.en: During a news conference at the White House, the head of the Federal Emergency Management Agency warned that the hurricane's strength should not be underestimated.
sentences.zh: 在白宫举行的新闻发布会上，联邦紧急事务管理局局长警告称，不应低估这场飓风的强度。

sentences.en: This storm will be deadly if we don't get out of harm's way and take it seriously.
sentences.zh: 如果我们不避开危险并认真对待，这场风暴将是致命的。

sentences.en: So I ask all Floridians to be vigilant and heed the warnings of your local officials.
sentences.zh: 所以我请求所有佛罗里达州民众保持警惕，并听从当地官员的警告。

sentences.en: If they tell you to evacuate, please do so immediately.
sentences.zh: 如果他们让你撤离，请立即执行。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Mary Wilson, Diana Nguyen, and Summer Tamod.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由玛丽·威尔逊、戴安娜·阮和萨默·塔莫德制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Rachel Quester, with help from Paige Cowett.
sentences.zh: 由雷切尔·奎斯特编辑，佩奇·考特提供协助。

sentences.en: Fact-checked by Susan Lee, contains original music by Marian Lozano and Dan Pell, and was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 由苏珊·李进行事实核查，包含玛丽安·洛萨诺和丹·佩尔的原创音乐，并由克里斯·伍德负责工程制作。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landfork of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰福克创作。

sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·罗森。

sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档关于热爱设计及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: and you turned a DJ booth into this living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你把DJ台变成了一个活生生的、充满美感且有50年历史的艺术品快闪博物馆。
